name: Elishua
title: David's son born in Jerusalem
summary: Elishua was one of King David's sons, born in Jerusalem after David had established his royal residence there. He is mentioned in the genealogies of David's children and is part of the royal family in Israel's united kingdom. The name Elishua means 'my God is salvation' and appears in David's family tree.

keyEvents.title: Born in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Elisjua was born in Jerusalem as one of David's sons after David became king over all Israel and took Jerusalem as his capital.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in David's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Elisjua is listed among David's sons in the genealogies of Chronicles, which document the royal line.

keyEvents.title: David's royal family in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: After David conquered Jerusalem and moved there, he had several sons and daughters, including Elisjua, who was part of the growing royal family.

keyEvents.title: David's establishment in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: David's conquest of Jerusalem and its establishment as Israel's capital set the context for Elisjua's birth and upbringing in the royal court.
